entries.en:
Qhoterl Pasol seeks to preserve the legacy of the Ronkans by gluing it back together again.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

entries.en: We've uncovered all sorts of precious relics, although some are in better condition than others.
entries.fr: Beaucouuup de reliquats de Ronka découverts durant récentes excavations ! Mais nombre d'entre eux très endommagés... Pas beau pas beau !
entries.ja:
これまでの発掘作業で、様々な遺物が発見されましたが、
残念なことに、破損しているものも多い様子～。

entries.en: As such, many of these artifacts are in desperate need of repair, which is where our special adhesive comes in particularly handy. Sadly, we've just run out, and need to prepare a fresh batch.
entries.fr: Qitari avoir immense respect pour ancêtres, et chérir leurs trésors pluuus que tout !  bien vouloir aider à restaurer reliquats ?
entries.ja:
祖先が残してくれた大切な宝ゆえ、
これを修復したく思いまするが、
それには足りぬものがございまする～。

entries.en: Oh my, this is perfection itself! Those priceless pots shall remain shattered no longer!
entries.fr: Merci merci, ça faire très plaisir de pouvoir rendre convenablement hommage à ancêtres ! Trésors dorénavant briller comme clic clic neuf !
entries.ja:
これなら、問題なく遺物を修復できまする～！
……一族の霊宝はもちろん大切でございまするが、
遺物を正しい形で受け継いでいくことも、また大切なこと～。

entries.en: While some may argue that the relics should be kept as we find them, I'd much rather see them restored to their original state, as the ancient Ronkans intended them. Besides, who would want to look at a pile of broken fragments?
entries.fr: Qhoterl Pasol devoir aussi apprendre à enfants à restaurer reliquats. Et quand enfants avoir enfants, enfants apprendre à enfants, hi hi !
entries.ja:
修復した遺物はうちの子たちへ、
そしてそのまた子供たちへ、必ず受け継いでいきましょ～！
